messages:
raja: starting fw canary rollout to ap-south1 (fw-2026.03.19) — seeing OOB VLAN remap on ~6 hosts, GPUs evicting training jobs. anyone oncall?

simon: on it, joining the rack console. can you paste the small log snippet you saw?

raja: here are the lines from the BMC syslog on rack-42-u07 and u08:
```
Mar 19 10:12:03 bmc kernel: netvlan: eth1: VLAN id changed from 100 to 220
Mar 19 10:12:04 bmc ipmi: lan channel 1 link status: down -> up (mgmt IP moved)
Mar 19 10:12:05 provisioning: pxeboot failed: no dhcp offer on management network
Mar 19 10:12:07 bmc secureboot: nvram flag toggled -> enabled
```

ops-bot: Canary check: 3/10 nodes failed post-flash checks, auto-pausing rollout :warning:. See canary report: https://ci.internal/reports/canary/3056789123

kevin: looks like OOB VLAN tag was remapped to a public mgmt VLAN on those NICs. likely vendor firmware set a default VLAN. `ipmitool lan print 1` on affected BMCs shows VLAN ID = 220.

jen: confirmed — secure boot bit unexpectedly set on rack-42-u07 and rack-42-u08 after the flash, causing them to fall back to BIOS PXE path and fail provisioning. Node ids: rack-42-u07, rack-42-u08.

raja: impact: cluster gpu utilisation dropped from 92% -> 58% as training jobs evicted and rescheduled, fallback to on-demand capacity in us-west increased cost today by ~14%. Need rollback plan asap.

infra-oncall: initiating rollback to fw-2026.03.17 for affected serial ranges (SN: 37A2-37A8). Runbook step 1->4 executed. Starting rollback now :arrow_down_small: (INF-TASK-1342).

simon: quick mitigation attempt: we can push an ipmitool raw/vlan set to revert tag before full rollback. example (vendor-specific):
```
# set VLAN back to 100 (may be NIC vendor-specific)
ipmitool lan set 1 vlan id 100
ipmitool lan set 1 ipsrc static
ipmitool lan print 1 | grep "VLAN ID"
```
Doing a test on rack-42-u09 (canary) — reporting success, BMC nic shows VLAN 100 again and provisioning retried.

ops-bot: Rollback queued: 6/6 affected nodes added to rollback job. ETA per node ~2m. Progress: 0/6 -> 6/6 (estimated finish in 12m). Notifying provisioning and scheduler.

kevin: post-rollback actions: add pre-flash nvram snapshot + post-flash `ipmitool lan print` assert to the firmware runbook. Also add vendor-specific VLAN override in the flash playbook. I'll open a PR for the runbook today.

jen: and add a check for secureboot nvram bit in the canary gating logic. schedule 24h canary window and only one rack at a time until we have telemetry. add alert: `oob.vlan.change` and `bmc.secureboot.toggled`.

raja: assigning follow-ups: @simon handle rollback ops and verify provisioning, @kevin create runbook PR and vendor override, @jen own postmortem and telemetry alerts. I'll create INFRA ticket INFRA-1342 and CC infra team.

ops-bot: All nodes back online (6/6) at 2026-03-19T10:32:40Z. Canary rollback success. Closing incident alert. :white_check_mark:

raja: thanks everyone. we'll keep the canary paused until runbook + telemetry items are in. moving to postmortem.
